[b][u]_______________________________________[/u][/b]

[list] | Sounds of construction echoed throughout the city's streets and alleyways being herd as a distinctive tone amid the disharmonious cacophony of the sounds of the city, the mixture of sounds; sirens, yells and horns along with the distinctive blare of voices from the top of buildings one becoming more bold than the others as the voice could be heard rather menacingly as it approached down the street, flowing smoothly through the slowly de-congesting traffic a simple van amid it's sides written in Ascoietjn and a symbol of a lone white star amid a blue background; [b]"The Blue Star Party"[/b] was all it read along the sides as the voice continued to defiantly speak, not through a mouth yet through speakers and megaphones hoisted along the top; // [i]Zetenvians! Ano'ayn Narijin! chuka ceneiyln Inat nariyi!, Ani'sian Zetenvia[/i] // for the common passerby's such was the normal life of living within a large city like, Sercenzia, many chose to ignore the political Vehicles for the sight of them after the reformation of the representative senate has become another fact of life. |

| Many of them still continued walking by sparce groups of foreign businessmen dressed in suits and some in more casual attire, yet the one thing that wasn't the norm was a descending staircase leading into the earth cornered off with chainlink fence upon it read simply;[i]"Coming Soon ANJR - Serceniza-Yatenia Line, Dept. of Civic Infrastructure"[/i]. |

| A Crowd began to form within a small cafe along the streets as a distinctive tone began to play and an emblem slid past, just as he came into view again. | [/list]

[spoiler= 376.82hz || Ch. 02 - The Official Ascoiyan National Broadcast | Thursday 3rd June, 2027]

[list] | That same voice and familar smile appeared on the screen as patrons within the cafe made their orders, and sat down some reading others paying attentive and undivided attention, others on their devices many of foreign make rarer few of Ascoiyan Brand | [/list]

[list][list] [i]" Isdentai Zeten-ati Inaka, I am your host. Ciastil-Zeten-Janis, coming to you live just from beyond the Presidential Estate right here in Sunny Serceniza, no hotter than 15 Celsius with clear skies being reported for rest of the week and onward for the rest of the month, but coastal provinces may see some storms at the end of the month!. "

" Now onto the news, coming straight from the Minister of Infrastructure herself, and the newly formed Department of Civic Infrastructure, as the most inquisitive amongst you have seen along the many streets and alleyways along the nation's largest cities, the development of underground tunnels and connections, ever since our reindustrialization and reopening to the global market, have come with it the creation of new ideas... these new 'Metros' or 'Sub-ways' as their called in lands far have finally made their way over to our nation, as of currently there are no more incentives than to connect these underground rail lines between provincial capitals let alone work has gotten underway with the Ser-Yat route yet the construction will be long and difficutl purely because of our separation by water the department head himself have said that such developments may cutdown ferry times and reduce the strain on the nation's travel to our Capitol."[/i] [/list][/list]

[list] | The Screen began to display a strange silica wafer, and a meeting room of officials as the host still continued to speak | [/list]

[list][list] [i]" While we have only gotten rumors thanks to the Alefiyn-Zetenvian Trade agreement and relations, our Aleif friends from lands far have recently put into our heads the latest talk of where Ascoiya should stand within the global economy, with some amongst the Rationalist party calling upon the Minster of Economy and the President himself to pull the nation out of an "Unskilled Force" to a "Skilled one" as the University of Serenti and other competitor universities have been calling upon the nation to develop what they call a "Technological Industry" recently in a bid professors and staff from numerous universities have presented their idea in a formal letter, more so a particular part calling upon the nation to "Begin Development of formal birth-place of electronic chips." 

"Until then we will return with more, but it seems it is all we have, so go enjoy the regular programming and enjoy the community and the environment!, Janten "[/i] [/list][/list]

[/spoiler]

[list] | Across the nation, in the Province of Ivenol the construction of a factory was underway, like others this one bore no smokestacks, and consisted of enormous water tanks, and strange devices in another factory an unknown order was placed and in intercepted phone calls a voice started to talk, with a confused tone; [i]"What is... Semi-Conductor?, I do not understand this Oteun idea.."[/i].

A Silent Economic Revolution was underway, the only thing that was needed was the research and concept before the first wafers started to be grinded down into useable chips, although that was a bigger task than creating it | [/list][/quote]
